components.name: App Tile
components.description: Booth-brown squircle with a dim label; lights a bulb ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-tile{width:150px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:none;border:0;padding:0;font-family:"Big Shoulders","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;cursor:pointer} .ds-tile:focus-visible{outline:0} .ds-tile-square{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:24%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#24120f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(167,129,75,.38),0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-tile-square svg{width:54%;height:54%} .ds-tile-square::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-13px;border-radius:calc(24% + 6px);border:5px dotted #ffd98c;opacity:0;transform:scale(.94);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,200,110,.85));transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);pointer-events:none} .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-square,.ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-square{transform:translateY(-7px) scale(1.05);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,217,140,.6),0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.55)} .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-square::after,.ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-square::after{opacity:1;transform:none} .ds-tile-label{font-size:26px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#bfae91;transition:color .3s ease} .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-label,.ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-label{color:#f6e9cc}

components.name: Episode Card
components.description: 16:9 continue-watching card with scrim, show name, meta and bulb progress.
components.css: .ds-resume{position:relative;width:320px;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:16px;background:#24120f;text-align:left;font-family:"Big Shoulders","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(167,129,75,.38),0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-resume:hover,.ds-resume:focus-visible{outline:0;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.04);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,217,140,.6),0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.55)} .ds-resume-art{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#5a1019,#2c070c)} .ds-resume-art::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 38%,rgba(10,4,5,.88) 100%)} .ds-resume-text{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px} .ds-resume-show{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.05;color:#f6e9cc} .ds-resume-meta{font-size:18px;font-weight:500;color:#d9c9ab} .ds-resume-progress{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:9px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd98c 40%,rgba(246,233,204,.22) 40%)}

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Fill-less large type; focus turns it bulb gold with a dotted underline.

components.name: Power Button
components.description: Logo-red circle; the only red control.
components.html: <button class="ds-power" aria-label="Power menu"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v8"/><path d="M6.3 6.8a8 8 0 1 0 11.4 0"/></svg></button>

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Booth-brown confirmation with display title and two text actions.
components.css: .ds-dialog{min-width:360px;padding:22px 36px 26px;border-radius:24px;background:#24120f;color:#f6e9cc;font-family:"Big Shoulders","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(167,129,75,.45),0 26px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.65)} .ds-dialog h2{font-size:48px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;margin:0 0 22px;letter-spacing:.01em} .ds-dialog-buttons{display:flex;gap:28px;justify-content:space-between} .ds-dialog-buttons button{font:inherit;font-size:36px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 6px;border:0;background:none;color:#bfae91;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s ease} .ds-dialog-buttons button:hover,.ds-dialog-buttons button:focus-visible{color:#ffd98c;outline:0;text-decoration:underline dotted 4px;text-underline-offset:9px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark field with brass border and bulb caret.

narrative.overview:
The living-room cinema at night. The house is near-black oxblood velvet with one warm spotlight falling from above; everything sits quietly in the dark until it is chosen, and then a ring of marquee bulbs lights around it while the rest of the house dims. Launching an app closes a velvet curtain behind the family; returning Home parts it again.

The screen is read from 2 to 4 m, so density is low and type is large: one condensed display face does every job, set in cream like bulb light. Brass hairlines frame every object instead of borders or fills. Motion is cinematic but restrained: the bulbs pulse slowly rather than chase, and the curtain is the one big move. The system refuses the smart-TV card wall with a blurred backdrop.
keyCharacteristics: Dark velvet house, one top-centre spotlight, vignette to the floor.
A single typeface (Big Shoulders, self-hosted) for every role.
Brass inset hairlines frame tiles, cards, panels and dialogs.
Focus is a dotted bulb ring plus lift; siblings dim to 62%.
Velvet curtain opens on boot and return, closes on launch.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Logo red appears on the B, the power button and selection, nowhere else. Focus is bulb gold, not red.

rules.name: The Dark House Rule
rules.body: At rest nothing glows. Light (bulb ring, cream label, lifted shadow) is the response to focus or hover.

rules.name: The Couch Distance Rule
rules.body: No text below 16px; every size is a clamp() keyed to viewport width so 1920x1080 over HDMI reads from the sofa.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: Controls and headings are lowercase as written in the copy; never force uppercase or letterspaced caps.

rules.name: The Hairline Frame Rule
rules.body: Raised surfaces are framed with an inset brass hairline, never an outer border.

dos: Do mark focus with the dotted bulb ring (5px dotted, 13px outside, slow 2.4s two-step pulse) plus lift, and dim siblings to 62%.
Do frame every raised surface with the brass inset hairline and a soft black drop shadow.
Do keep every size a viewport clamp() with nothing below 16px.
Do ease state changes on cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and collapse all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do self-host the font; the box may boot offline.
donts: Don't use logo red for focus, accents or decoration beyond the B, the power button and selection.
Don't animate the bulbs as a running chase or add glow at rest.
Don't build a smart-TV card wall with a blurred backdrop.
Don't introduce a second typeface or uppercase letterspaced labels.
